resources.string: No folders added. The built-in demoness sample is ready.
ARMED · begins and ends with protection
RUNNING · STOP STORM always remains available
SETUP NEEDED · allow display over other apps
SETUP NEEDED · acknowledge the photosensitivity warning
SubHub needs Android’s display-over-other-apps permission to show Popup Storm and its persistent stop control.
Enable Popup Storm and allow overlay access first.

Popup Storm spawns moving images at random screen positions, sometimes in quick bursts. If you have epilepsy, photosensitive seizures, migraines, or feel unwell from rapid visual changes, do not enable it.\n\nA persistent STOP STORM control remains above every popup. Android’s notification can also stop protection.
Overlay and notification access are ready.

1. Open Filter rules and choose what to hide.
2. Assign apps in Settings.
3. Tap Start Protection on Home.
4. Approve any Android permission shown.
5. Stop from Home or the notification.
Display over other apps lets SubHub place censors above other apps. Screen Capture asks for Android approval at each start. App Mode needs Accessibility enabled once.

App Mode is the persistent option: enable Accessibility once, assign the apps to censor, and SubHub wakes only where you told it to. Selected-app mode sleeps after you leave an assigned app. Screen Capture watches the approved screen until that session ends. Android secure windows can block either method.

Safe Browser includes tabs, bookmarks, pre-blur, ad filtering, and censored downloads. Private tabs clear their history, cache, forms, and site storage when closed, but Android WebView still shares first-party cookies between SubHub tabs.

Export censors selected gallery images on device and saves new copies. Optional source deletion always requires a second confirmation and may trigger an additional Android provider prompt. Browser images can be downloaded normally or scanned and censored before saving.
Changes apply live. Saved Setups remember complete censor configurations; Censor Packs add themes, phrases, and images.

Popup Storm can spawn moving images in rapid bursts. Read and accept the photosensitivity warning before enabling it. A separate STOP STORM control remains above every popup. Stopping the storm does not trap the device, disable Android controls, or prevent uninstalling SubHub.

Use Fix Next Permission if censors do not appear. Diagnostics shows service state, detector, frame rate, latency, and recent errors. If App Mode stalls, turn SubHub off and on again in Android Accessibility.

Detection, app assignments, statistics, setups, packs, diagnostics, and Wallet history stay on this device. Screen snapshots are analyzed locally and are not saved. PayPal credentials and saved-wallet IDs are encrypted; checkout and risk data go directly to PayPal. Browser traffic still goes to the sites you visit.
After restart, SubHub restores the last protection state. A sealed pact always re-arms App Mode when Android allows it. Screen Capture still needs fresh Android approval.
